narrative.world1mission1texto: Aren, a young explorer, enters the Enchanted Forest following an ancient map. Legend says that the First Crystal of Wisdom lies deep within the forest. The path seems peaceful, but the adventure is only beginning.
narrative.world1mission2texto: A loud crash breaks the silence. A huge rock falls in front of Aren and blocks the path. He will have to find another way to continue his journey.
narrative.world1mission3texto: As he goes around the rock, a cracking sound shakes the forest. An ancient tree falls in front of Aren, blocking the entire path. It is too big to jump over or go around: he must find a way through.
narrative.world1mission4texto: The sky darkens and heavy rain begins to fall. The forest changes completely, and every step becomes harder.
narrative.world1mission5texto: Thick fog covers the forest. He can barely make out the path, and every shadow seems to hide a danger.
narrative.world1mission6texto: The howls of wolves echo from the darkness. A lone traveler appears among the trees and warns Aren that the pack will only let someone pass who understands the order of their gazes. Something strange and wild is hidden within this stranger.
narrative.world1mission7texto: The trees are enormous, and the forest is completely silent. Aren feels that he is very close to discovering an ancient secret.
narrative.world1mission8texto: After a long walk, he finds an old wooden bridge that creaks with every step. A strange blue light seems to shine on the other side.
narrative.world1mission9texto: Across the bridge, he discovers an ancient sanctuary covered in roots. At its center shines the First Crystal of Wisdom, protected by a mysterious energy.
narrative.world1mission10texto: Aren brings the First Crystal to the dormant portal, but an emerald presence blocks his way. The Forest Guardian will only allow the crystal to awaken the portal if he proves worthy of crossing into other worlds.
narrative.world2mission1texto: Aren crosses the portal and a scorching gust welcomes him to the Lost Desert. The magical passage closes behind him as the wind erases his first footprints. Unable to return, he spots distant ruins and begins searching for the Golden Crystal.
narrative.world2mission2texto: A wall of sand covers the horizon and erases the trail. Aren shields the map as he moves among ancient marker stones. When the wind briefly clears, he discovers that the distant ruins belong to a forgotten observatory.
narrative.world2mission3titulo: The Ruins of the Four Winds
narrative.world2mission3texto: Four obelisks surround a sand-covered platform. Between them lies a network of stone channels that can carry solar energy. If Aren rotates the slabs and guides the light to the central core, the observatory will reveal the route to the Golden Crystal.
narrative.world2mission4texto: The sand begins to rise like a wave. A gigantic creature travels beneath the dunes, heading straight for Aren. The Dune Devourer emerges with a roar, covered in ancient markings that glow with a strange energy.
narrative.world2mission5texto: Four oases appear at once, although none are marked on the map. Inside one of the mirages, a young wizard named Zafir calls for help. To free him, Aren must decipher the inscriptions and discover which water belongs to the real world.
narrative.world2mission6texto: Freed from the illusion, Zafir explains that the temple’s corrupted energy awakened the Dune Devourer. In a buried caravan they find supplies and the final trail marker. From now on they will continue the expedition together. Among the caravan’s remains, an ink quill moves with no one holding it.
narrative.world2mission7texto: The canyon walls tremble. The worm has found them, and every new charge collapses part of the path. Aren and Zafir run toward the outline of the temple as the creature closes in behind them.
narrative.world2mission8texto: One last storm sweeps the sand from the mountain, revealing a monumental door. Five linked solar mirrors surround the seal. Only a correctly directed beam of light can open the entrance.
narrative.world2mission9texto: At the heart of the temple, dark roots surround the crystal chamber. The Dune Devourer bursts through the wall, but Zafir recognizes the same corrupted markings on its armor. The creature is also a prisoner of that force.
narrative.world2mission10texto: With the corruption broken, the Dune Devourer grows calm and reveals the Golden Crystal beneath the sand. Before handing it over, Zafir proposes one last battle of words: he wants to be sure Aren is ready to carry the crystal into the next world.
narrative.world3mission1texto: The portal places Aren on an island suspended in an ocean of clouds. In the distance, an impossible storm surrounds the ruins of the Celestial Peaks, and the way back fades away.
narrative.world3mission2titulo: The Bridge That Forgot the Wind
narrative.world3mission2texto: Fragments of an ancient bridge float out of place. Their air channels still hold magic: if they are aligned again, the wind can rebuild the crossing.
narrative.world3mission3texto: A small blue dragon descends from above. His name is Nimbus, and he believes Aren has come to steal his family’s crystal. He defends the path with a roar that is far braver than it is fierce.
narrative.world3mission4texto: Nimbus disappears into the clouds. To follow him, Aren must find the celestial spark that opens the currents of the sky. Three crystal bells change places to protect it.
narrative.world3mission5texto: The storm scatters the islands and threatens to make them collide. Their shadows and currents reveal a safe order, but Aren must act before the path breaks apart again.
narrative.world3mission6texto: In a hidden shelter, Aren finds a small nest, carved toys, and pieces of an eggshell. The fearsome guardian is only a hatchling trying to find his missing mother.
narrative.world3mission7texto: Nimbus returns and accepts Aren’s help. Together they cross the lightning that chains the storm and search for a safe route to the Matriarch’s sanctuary.
narrative.world3mission8texto: After crossing the storm, they reach the sanctuary of Aeralis, Matriarch of the Sky. Four doors, one for each wind, protect the chamber where she was sealed away.
narrative.world3mission9texto: Aeralis used the Celestial Crystal to contain a corrupted storm, but became trapped inside it. Aren and Nimbus must break the four seals without releasing the darkness they contain.
narrative.world3mission10texto: With Aeralis free, Nimbus understands that Aren is no thief. Even so, he proposes one final battle of words: he will only give the crystal to someone who swears to protect it in the worlds still ahead.
narrative.world4mission1texto: Aeralis leaves Aren on the snow and sets off back to the Celestial Peaks. A sudden blizzard erases the path behind him. In the distance, an enormous yeti crosses the ridge and disappears into the snow.
narrative.world4mission2texto: The path ends at a frozen lake. Aren follows the footprints that the blizzard briefly reveals and reaches the far shore just before the ice begins to crack.
narrative.world4mission3texto: A boreal fox with a crystalline tail follows the glowing tracks through the frozen forest. A force that crystallizes the forest has unsettled its creatures. Aren must connect crystals of three colors without crossing their currents to restore the aurora’s light to the path.
narrative.world4mission4texto: Aren finds an entire village trapped in ice. Its inhabitants stand motionless beneath the frost, the lanterns still glow, and every clock stopped at the same moment. A dark mark that does not belong to Nivor appears on a tower.
narrative.world4mission5texto: The observatory’s instruments recorded the beginning of the thaw. Among its maps, Aren discovers that someone caused the disaster before offering Nivor the power to stop it.
narrative.world4mission6texto: Nivor descends upon the observatory and accuses Aren of wanting to destroy the boreal dragons’ last refuge. He will accept no explanation: to continue, Aren must face him directly.
narrative.world4mission7texto: After the battle, Aren enters the fortress and finds the last dragon egg trapped in a maze of black ice. He must tilt the ancient mechanism and carefully guide it to the nest to free it.
narrative.world4mission8texto: Three cores feed the storm covering the kingdom. Aren must balance their energy: too much cold will freeze the mechanism, and too much heat will shatter the fortress.
narrative.world4mission9texto: In the deepest chamber, Aren finds the final proof: Azrak caused the thaw and then used Nivor’s fear to steal energy from the Glacial Crystal.
narrative.world4mission10texto: Nivor sees the proof, but accepting the truth would mean acknowledging all the harm he has caused. Consumed by guilt and pride, he unleashes Absolute Zero and challenges Aren one last time.
narrative.world5mission1texto: The four crystals lead Aren to Azrak’s kingdom. Behind him, the rift closes. A green ember among the rocks reminds him that there is still life to protect.
narrative.world5mission2texto: The bridge falls apart over the abyss. Five runes lie hidden among the ruins. Aren must find the leaf, sun, cloud, snowflake, and star to rebuild the path.
narrative.world5mission3texto: Shadow descends from the tower and blocks the way. “No one reaches Azrak without facing me.” Aren prepares himself: he must defeat the sentinel to continue.
narrative.world5mission4texto: Lume’s light has restored Aren’s strength. At the forge, he discovers that Shadow took her to the Eclipse Chamber for rescuing him. There, Azrak weakened the Crystal of Unity. Aren promises to find her.
narrative.world5mission5texto: The guardians answer the crystals. To open a path for them, Aren must return each symbol to its seal: forest, desert, sky, and winter.
narrative.world5mission6texto: Azrak orders Shadow to destroy the bridge, even though his own sentinels are still crossing it. Shadow hesitates. Aren realizes that beneath that armor, a will of his own still remains.
narrative.world5mission7texto: Aren recognizes the guardian who saved him. “Lume, I came for you.” Azrak has created a deceptive copy of her chamber. Seven details betray the illusion: finding them will break Lume’s bonds.
narrative.world5mission8texto: Lume still holds the fifth crystal, although Azrak weakened its light. “With every word you recover, I can light a portal and call the guardians.” Four words will awaken the paths of forest, desert, sky, and winter.
narrative.world5mission9texto: Aren walks alone toward the throne. Lume stays with the fifth crystal, holding the four portals open to bring the guardians. Shadow waits at the door. “I swore loyalty to him,” he says. Aren replies: “You can still choose whom to protect.”
narrative.world5mission10texto: Shadow draws his blade before Azrak’s throne. First, Aren must defeat the sentinel. Behind him waits the one who chained the four worlds.
narrative.cinema0: Nivor folds his wings. Aren won the duel, but the dragon still refuses to reveal what he is protecting in the fortress.
narrative.cinema1: A violet pulse crosses the storm. As Nivor looks at the fortress, his fury turns to alarm.
narrative.cinema2: Without explaining, Nivor takes flight and races back. His retreat leaves a clue: inside, there is something he fears losing.
narrative.cinema3: Nimbus lowers his head. The battle was not about pride: he wanted to know whether Aren would protect his family.
narrative.cinema4: His call echoes through the clouds. The last seals fade, and Aeralis, Matriarch of the Sky, finally spreads her wings.
narrative.cinema5: Aeralis recognizes the Green Crystal and the Golden Crystal. Aren did not come to steal: he is restoring balance to the five worlds.
narrative.cinema6: The Matriarch frees the Celestial Crystal and entrusts it to Aren. Nimbus promises to stand by his oath in the Versus arena.
narrative.cinema7: There is no need to open another portal. Aeralis lowers one of her enormous wings and offers to carry Aren to the fourth world.
narrative.cinema8: Aren settles among the Matriarch’s scales. With a powerful beat of her wings, the Celestial Peaks fall behind them.
narrative.cinema9: Together they cross the sea of clouds. The air grows colder and colder, and beneath the aurora, a kingdom of ice appears.
narrative.cinema10: WORLD 4 · Aeralis leaves Aren safely on the snow and returns to Nimbus. From here, he must continue exploring alone.
narrative.cinema11: Aeralis disappears beyond the blizzard. Snow erases her tracks, and from the ridge, Nivor’s silhouette watches Aren’s every step.
narrative.cinema12: The evidence beneath the glacier was true: Azrak caused the thaw and turned Nivor’s fear into a chain. The dragon breaks his pact and frees the last boreal egg.
narrative.cinema13: Looking upon the kingdom he condemned to ice, Nivor lowers his head. A crystalline tear falls onto the snow. “My fear turned this home into a prison.”
narrative.cinema14: At dawn, Nivor entrusts Aren with the Glacial Crystal. He does not ask for his mistakes to be forgotten: he promises to repair them and face Azrak alongside the guardians of the four worlds.
narrative.cinema15: The Glacial Crystal awakens the other three. The four do more than restore the worlds: together, they reveal the way to the Fifth Seal.
narrative.cinema16: Azrak appears among the flames: “At last, you gathered the four keys. You thought you were restoring the worlds… but you were also opening the way to me.”
narrative.cinema17: Nivor tries to close the rift, but Azrak shatters the ice with one hand. “Your pact is over, Nivor. Now your debt begins.”
narrative.cinema18: The rift becomes a portal. Nivor stays beside the egg: “I will protect this kingdom. You finish what we guardians began.”
narrative.cinema20: “Halt, traveler! I am the Guardian of this forest. I have watched every trial you overcame to reach the portal.”
narrative.cinema22: “The crystal answered your courage, but I will not let its power cross the portal without one final test. I challenge you to a duel.”
narrative.cinema25: You freed the Dune Devourer, but the crystal needs a prepared guardian. Defeat me in a battle of words, and I will help you carry it to the next world.
narrative.cinema27: Now free of corruption, the Dune Devourer reveals the Golden Crystal it guarded beneath its body.
narrative.cinema29: The creature pushes the crystal toward Aren. The chase is over: it trusts him now.
narrative.cinema31: Zafir levitates the crystal and uses his magic to remove the last traces of corrupted sand.
narrative.cinema33: Clean and radiant, the second Crystal of Wisdom finally passes into Aren’s hands.
narrative.cinema35: Zafir opens a portal among the clouds. Beyond it awaits a world of mountains and floating islands.
narrative.cinema37: You passed his trial and recovered the Golden Crystal. Zafir joins your champions in Versus mode.
narrative.cinema41: You rebuilt the seal and overcame the forest’s trials.
narrative.cinema42: Your courage proves you worthy. Accept the Crystal of Wisdom; may its light guide your path.
narrative.cinema46: Aren reaches the end of the trail. Suddenly, leaves hang motionless and a stranger blocks his way. “I am Kairós. Your journey ends here… unless you can defeat me.”
narrative.cinema48: A ring of energy flies toward Aren. The explorer shields himself and takes his stance. Kairós smiles: “Prove you can keep going.” The duel begins!
narrative.cinema50: After his defeat, Kairós clears the path and returns to a hidden sanctuary. He bows before a shadowy figure: “I carried out your task. I tested the explorer.”
narrative.cinema52: “Aren defeated me. He is brave and can think under pressure. I believe he could gather the crystals.” The silhouette remains silent as a green light begins to reveal her.
narrative.cinema54: The light reveals her face. “Thank you, Kairós. You were right to test him,” the Guardian replies. “Let him continue. When he reaches my sanctuary, I will see for myself whether he is ready.”
narrative.cinema56: Among the buried wagons appears a young man covered in scrolls. “Cálamo, at your service. I can decipher that last sign,” he says. Aren shows him the map, but Zafir keeps his eyes on the inkwell.
narrative.cinema58: A ribbon of ink tears the letters from the map. “A mere human thinks he can save the worlds? You cannot even protect your own words,” Cálamo mocks. Aren clutches the parchment: “Give them back!”
narrative.cinema60: A blast of ink throws Aren onto the sand. His arm hurts, and he struggles to rise. Zafir kneels beside him: “You are hurt. This journey could cost you your life. Why keep going when you know how hard it is for a human?”
narrative.cinema62: “Because there are people still waiting for help. I am afraid, Zafir. But if I leave, nothing will change.” Aren takes the wizard’s hand and stands. “Then we continue together,” Zafir replies. Cálamo still blocks the way: the duel begins.
narrative.cinema64: Defeated, Cálamo opens the inkwell. The letters return to the map and reveal the path to the temple. “You won, explorer. But beware: what sleeps beneath the sand is also a prisoner.” Before Zafir can question him, the scribe vanishes among splashes of ink.
narrative.cinema68: Aren wins the duel. But Shadow rises and releases a blast the explorer cannot dodge. Aren falls, badly wounded. “This is not over yet,” the sentinel says.
narrative.cinema70: A light intervenes. “I am Lume, the fifth guardian, protector of the Crystal of Unity.” Her shield stops Shadow as her magic begins healing Aren’s wounds.
narrative.cinema72: “My light will restore your strength. Cross the portal, Aren. I will hold him back.” Lume helps him reach safety. “I will come back for you,” he promises before crossing the light.
narrative.cinema74: The portal closes. Exhausted by the rescue, Lume cannot escape Shadow’s bonds. The sentinel takes her to the Eclipse Chamber. There, on Azrak’s orders, the Fifth Seal weakens her crystal.
narrative.cinema75: Shadow falls to his knees. Aren lowers his weapon: “You do not have to keep obeying him.”
narrative.cinema76: “You are no longer useful to me,” Azrak declares. A blast strikes Shadow and opens a rift beneath his feet.
narrative.cinema77: The rift closes amid violet smoke. No trace of Shadow remains. Aren steps forward: “It is over, Azrak.”
narrative.cinema78: Azrak laughs: “You are going to stop me? A mere human, with no wings or magic of your own. You have no chance.”
narrative.cinema79: Aren trembles but takes a step forward: “I am afraid. I also have people to keep going for. If you knock me down, I will get up again.”
narrative.cinema80: The duel is won, but Azrak absorbs the throne’s energy. The guardians cross the portal: this time, Aren will not fight alone.
narrative.cinema81: A roar shakes the throne. Azrak’s three-headed hound rises over the guardians, as enormous as a tower. Its three heads breathe fire, and Aren barely has time to raise his sword.
narrative.cinema82: Before the fire reaches them, a beam of ice bursts from the portal Lume is holding open. Two giant claws grip the stone. Nivor has answered the call!
narrative.cinema83: Nivor emerges from the portal before the hound. Fire and ice collide above the guardians. The dragon advances through the steam and raises a wall of ice to contain the beast.
narrative.cinema84: Azrak launches an attack at Aren while Nivor holds back the hound. Nimbus dives between them and catches him in flight. For a moment, time seems to stand still.
narrative.cinema85: Another blast cuts through the sky. Aeralis intervenes: her radiant breath meets Azrak’s attack and protects her son and Aren.
narrative.cinema86: Nivor extinguishes the last flames and traps the hound in an enormous prison of ice. Its three heads bow: the beast is defeated. Now the dragon turns his gaze toward Azrak.
narrative.cinema87: With the hound defeated and trapped in ice, Nivor freezes Azrak’s feet and pins his arm to the ground. “You will never chain my family again.”
narrative.cinema88: The Guardian weaves her roots into Zafir’s magic. The Guardian of the Moon cuts through the shadows, and Lume, the guardian Aren freed from the eclipse, opens a breach of light in Azrak’s defenses.
narrative.cinema89: Azrak rallies. He shatters the roots and spreads a dark wave across the arena. The guardians fall back; Aren can barely stay on his feet.
narrative.cinema90: A shadow intercepts the blow. Shadow returns: he used the rift to escape. Azrak reaches out, but his former sentinel turns toward Aren.
narrative.cinema91: “My oath no longer belongs to you. I choose whom to protect.” Shadow opens a path through the storm and calls on the guardians to gather their power.
narrative.cinema92: Ice, sky, forest, sun, moon, and shadow unite. Aren raises the four crystals, and Lume adds the fifth crystal’s light from the portal. Together they reach the heart of the Fifth Seal and break Azrak’s power.
narrative.cinema93: The storm fades. Azrak is trapped inside the seal he sought to control. Lume arrives with the Crystal of Unity, restored to its full light when the Fifth Seal broke, and gives it to Aren. The five crystals restore the paths between worlds, and Shadow stays beside those he chose to protect.
narrative.cinema94: Aren puts away his map. No single strength saved the worlds: learning to listen to one another and choosing to help did. THE END · Thank you for sharing this adventure.
narrative.cinema95: “I will not allow it!” Azrak fires a blast toward the group. If it reaches them now, their union will remain incomplete.
narrative.cinema96: A confident smile beneath the mask. “Sorry I am late.”
narrative.cinema97: The blast strikes a barrier of ink. “This time I did not come to steal anything from you, Aren. Finish what you started!”
narrative.cinema98: Cálamo binds Azrak’s arms with ribbons of ink. “I cannot hold him forever!” The guardians seize those precious seconds.
narrative.cinema99: The guardians give their energy. The five crystals gather it around Aren: everyone believes in him.
narrative.cinema100: The light transforms Aren. His heart remains the same; now he carries the strength of all the worlds.
narrative.cinema101: “For everyone waiting for us!” Aren focuses the power he received and directs it at the heart of the Fifth Seal.
narrative.cinema102: Crystal climbs up Azrak’s legs. “No! How could you break my power?” he shouts, struggling to escape.
narrative.cinema103: The seal reaches his shoulders. “I ruled these worlds! How could I lose to you?” His voice begins to fade.
narrative.cinema104: Silence gives way to hope. The guardians surround Aren and gather the five crystals, finally safe.
narrative.cinema105: The armor of light dissolves into tiny sparks. Aren becomes the familiar explorer again. His friends welcome him with pride.
narrative.cinema106: Aren brings his hands toward the crystals. With the guardians’ help, he sends their light through the portals to each world.
narrative.cinema107: In Nivor’s kingdom, the ice imprisoning its people begins to melt. Aren’s light flows through its streets.
narrative.cinema108: The frozen people awaken and embrace again. The kingdom keeps its snow, but the cold no longer steals their lives.
narrative.cinema109: The shadows leave the Enchanted Forest. The roots open, the trees regain their leaves, and water flows again.
narrative.cinema110: The animals leave their hiding places. Where fear once lived, flowers now grow. The forest breathes peacefully again.
narrative.cinema111: In the desert, the storm clears. The oasis regains its waters, and the ancient paths connect its people once more.
narrative.cinema112: Gardens bloom again beneath the palms. The desert remains golden, but it is once again a home full of life.
narrative.cinema113: The dark clouds part. The bridges of the Celestial Peaks shine again, and the wind once more supports their islands.
narrative.cinema114: Nimbus and Aeralis fly together across a free sky. The paths between worlds remain open to everyone.
narrative.cinema115: The guardians embrace Aren. Off to one side, Shadow watches with folded arms and a quiet smile: in his own way, he celebrates too.
narrative.cinema116: Aren puts away his map. The adventure taught them that no power is greater than helping one another. THE END · Thank you for saving the worlds.
narrative.cinema117: “Because we learned to help one another,” Aren replies. The seal closes. Azrak can no longer hurt them.
narrative.cinema118:
For a moment, the five worlds fell silent.
After so much darkness, life found its way again.

narrative.extra76: The Legend of the Five Crystals
narrative.extra77: Many years ago, five Crystals of Wisdom kept the worlds in balance. Their guardians had sworn to protect them so their power would never fall into the wrong hands.
narrative.extra78: The five crystals illuminate an ancient sanctuary.
narrative.extra80: One night, Azrak came to the sanctuary seeking the crystals. The guardians tried to stop him but could not defeat him. To keep the crystals safe, they separated them and fled with them to different kingdoms.
narrative.extra81: A shadow engulfs the crystals and darkens the sanctuary.
narrative.extra83: Since then, no one had heard from the guardians. A strange darkness began spreading across the worlds. Aren, a young explorer, found an ancient map: its first clue led him to the Enchanted Forest.
narrative.extra84: Aren discovers a route on an ancient map.
narrative.extra86: Aren set out to find the guardians. To gather the crystals and restore balance to the worlds, he would have to earn their trust and discover how to stop the darkness.
narrative.extra87: Aren begins his journey through the Enchanted Forest.
narrative.more0: The life of the forest goes with you, Aren.
narrative.more1: My magic will be yours. Trust what you have learned.
narrative.more2: Take my strength. We will not leave you alone.
narrative.more3: For my family and for those waiting to awaken.
narrative.more4: Come on, Aren! Let us open the sky again.
narrative.more5: May our light protect your path.
narrative.more6: The fifth crystal answers. Receive the light of Unity.
narrative.more7: This time, my power serves to protect.
narrative.more10: The Green Crystal is back where it belongs.
narrative.more11: Thanks to your courage, the Enchanted Forest has regained some of its ancient magic. But the adventure is far from over.
narrative.more12: As you cross the portal, a gust of hot air replaces the forest’s fresh scent. Before you stretches a vast ocean of sand, where the wind erases paths and hides ancient secrets.
narrative.more13: Legends tell of a powerful crystal hidden beneath the dunes. Many explorers tried to find it... but none returned to tell their story.
narrative.more14: Now only you can discover the desert’s Golden Crystal and continue restoring balance to the five worlds.
narrative.battle0: Azrak absorbs the throne’s energy. The guardians arrive: Aren is no longer alone.
narrative.battle1: Azrak’s three-headed hound rises like a tower. Its three heads breathe fire at the guardians.
narrative.battle2: Lume holds the portal open. Two icy claws pierce the light: Nivor has answered!
narrative.battle3: Fire and ice collide. Nivor raises a wall to contain the hound.
narrative.battle4: Azrak aims at Aren. Nimbus catches him in flight and carries him away from the blow.
narrative.battle5: Aeralis protects her son and Aren. Her radiant breath stops the attack.
narrative.battle6: Nivor traps the hound in ice. The beast is defeated.
narrative.battle7: The dragon pins Azrak down. “You will never chain my family again.”
narrative.battle8: Roots, magic, moon, and light open a breach. The guardians fight together.
narrative.battle9: Azrak breaks his bonds. A dark wave forces everyone back.
narrative.battle10: Shadow returns and stops the blow. He no longer obeys Azrak.
narrative.battle11: “I choose whom to protect.” Shadow calls on the guardians to gather their power.
narrative.alt0: Aren and the enormous dragon Nivor face each other after their first duel
narrative.alt1: A violet alarm lights the fortress and alerts Nivor
narrative.alt2: Nivor flies back to the fortress as Aren watches

narrative.alt4: Aren sits on Aeralis’s back before takeoff
narrative.alt5: Aeralis carries Aren above the clouds toward the frozen world
narrative.alt6: Aren says goodbye to Aeralis in the Ice World
narrative.alt7: Nivor breaks the black ice chains holding the last boreal egg
narrative.alt8: Nivor sheds a tear as he looks at the kingdom he froze
narrative.alt9: Nivor gives Aren the Glacial Crystal at dawn
narrative.alt10: The four crystals open a red and black rift in the aurora
narrative.alt11: Azrak’s giant projection appears inside the rift
narrative.alt12: Nivor tries to freeze the rift while Azrak destroys the ice
narrative.alt13: Aren looks at the portal to Azrak’s volcanic kingdom as Nivor protects the egg

s0.title: Complete the word
s0.description: You play as the Guardian. C and T are revealed and have added 2 skill charge. Completing a word takes one heart from your opponent.
s0.action: Tap A on the combat keyboard.

s1.title: Watch your attempts
s1.description: Now find DOG. A wrong letter uses an attempt, but you still keep your heart.
s1.action: Try X and watch your attempts.

s2.title: When attempts run out
s2.description: Five attempts remain. Try the highlighted letters: running out costs one heart and adds a random word from the same topic.
s2.action: Try B, C, F, H and J, one at a time.

s3.title: Charge your skill
s3.description: Find GOOSE. Each revealed letter adds charge; O appears twice. This word will fill your bar to 8/8.
s3.action: Tap G, O, S and E to fill the bar.

s4.title: Cast your skill
s4.description: Entangling Roots is ready. Use it and watch the animation and the opponent keyboard window: their keys become trapped.

s5.title: Now it comes your way
s5.description: Zafir will cast Arcane Chaos. Watch the skill travel and rearrange your keys.
s5.action: Your opponent waits until you are ready.

s6.title: Play with the effect
s6.description: We paused the effect so you can inspect it. The keys moved, but kept their letters. In a match the effect lasts 5 seconds.
s6.action: Find and tap O on the shuffled keyboard.

s7.title: Win the battle
s7.description: We moved practice to the opponent’s last heart. Complete TIGER to see the Guardian’s final attack and victory cinematic.
